description:
The Headphone and Accessories Team at Apple is actively looking for a highly motivated Software Engineer to develop innovative technologies. Candidate is expected to be proficient in software development and C/C++ programming. We value individuals who are driven to innovate and possess a strong desire to learn new skills. 

Description
As a Software Engineer on the Headphone and Accessories team, you will play a crucial role in developing and implementing cutting-edge technologies for next-generation headphones and accessories. 

Responsibilities
As part of a small team of specialized engineers, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative features for devices such as AirPods, which are highly regarded and widely used by millions of people worldwide. Your work will span across Connectivity, AIML, Audio Engineering, Computer Vision and other areas, allowing you to create very unique and impactful end-to-end features.

Minimum qualifications
BS with 2+ years of industry experience or MS preferred
You have strong experience with Software Development and C/C++ programming
You have a good understanding of Operating Systems concepts

Preferred qualifications
* You're experienced with Machine Learning or AI
* You're experienced with Computer Vision
* You're experienced with Audio Systems Engineering
* You're experienced with Multimodal Machine Learning
You're experienced with Embedded Firmware development
You have in depth knowledge of C, C++, and/or Python programming languages
You're a strong team player with the ability to work collaboratively and effectively with others
You're a self-starter with the ability to take initiative and manage tasks independently
You have proven experience presenting to leadership, including delivering effective presentations and communicating complex information clearly
You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Internal Details
all_locations: San Diego, United States of America
